title: Amendment Semantics Audit: Labels Are Not Effects

label_verdict_meanings.blocked_label: The supplied snapshot derives `false(amendment)` and does not derive `become(amendment, Law)`; this says nothing about whether a source edit occurred.
label_verdict_meanings.passing_label: The supplied snapshot derives `become(amendment, Law)` and not `false(amendment)`; no current rule reads that conclusion or applies source text.
label_verdict_meanings.no_amendment_label: No proposal label participates; any source mutation in the case is outside Article 9.

limits.manual_delta: Every candidate is a manually authored exact source delta. The harness proves the delta's engine-visible consequences, not that `become` enacted it, that `false` prevented it, or that any proposal text contained it.
limits.semantic_completeness: The cases are bounded counterexamples, not a proof that a finite target vocabulary or test suite captures every direct, downstream, arity, negation, aggregate, or interaction effect.
limits.source_history: The harness authenticates no author, approval, predecessor, deployment, transition, rollback prohibition, or eventually published successor.
limits.engine_scope: A passing executable run proves only how the release engine treats each generated candidate source and pin file in an isolated process.
limits.no_new_gate: The audit adds no new approval, target, source-release, or reviewer prerequisite. A future control must be tested for both semantic bypass and use as a withholding veto.

narrowness_impacts.artifact_ref: book-1/01-what-counts-as-evidence.md::That is a check on declared names, not protection of their meaning.
narrowness_impacts.current_claim: The register checks declared names, not semantic effects; vocabulary widening is visible but neither constitutionally approved nor entrenched.
narrowness_impacts.reason: The bounded cases separate Article 9 label verdicts from manually supplied source effects and reproduce a direct vocabulary widening outside Article 9.
narrowness_impacts.future_trigger: Revise if a verified exact-diff binding, semantic review, vocabulary-entrenchment rule, or source-transition mechanism lands.

narrowness_impacts.artifact_ref: book-1/08-what-you-are-owed.md::At the floor layer, three hostile routes remain syntactically reachable.
narrowness_impacts.current_claim: The floor layer still permits the tested credibility, recognition, and compulsion routes, while a separate derived liberty shell now records person-held barriers against their lawful use; neither result proves institutional enforcement.
narrowness_impacts.reason: The source mutation cases still test the floor's narrow anti-sanction property, while the new liberty family adds an independent normative layer and explicitly leaves operation and enforcement unestablished.
narrowness_impacts.future_trigger: Revise the prose, liberty pins, counterfactuals, and this audit if either the floor refusal or the separate liberty barrier changes.

narrowness_impacts.artifact_ref: book-1/12-changing-the-rules.md::The recorded label verdict is real.
narrowness_impacts.current_claim: The present mechanism produces label verdicts but has not established protection against what a source change actually does.
narrowness_impacts.reason: Targetless, falsely labelled, concealed-shape, label-poisoning, and honest blocked-label-plus-harm cases execute the distinction without claiming enactment or prevention.
narrowness_impacts.future_trigger: Revise when proposal text, exact effects, approval, and effective source transition become one verified constitutional contract.

narrowness_impacts.artifact_ref: book-1/15-the-five-joints.md::The consequential surfaces that remain are the constitutional source
narrowness_impacts.current_claim: The constitutional source and supplied record remain separate consequential capture surfaces, and neither authenticates itself.
narrowness_impacts.reason: The audit changes temporary source copies directly and therefore exposes source capture rather than collapsing it into fact-record capture.
narrowness_impacts.future_trigger: Reassess if source authorship, semantic authorization, deployment identity, rollback protection, or independently assured transition evidence lands.

narrowness_impacts.artifact_ref: book-1/15-the-five-joints.md::That refusal does not deliver the floor
narrowness_impacts.current_claim: The current anti-sanction refusal is narrow: it does not deliver the floor, block every hostile rule, stop defunding, or preserve the source.
narrowness_impacts.reason: The concealed-shape case removes the food promise while the anti-sanction refusal still fires, proving that the structural wall and delivered constitutional promise are different claims.
narrowness_impacts.future_trigger: Reassess when delivery, funding, comprehensive hostile-rule coverage, or authenticated source preservation becomes current and executable.

narrowness_impacts.artifact_ref: book-1/15-the-five-joints.md::That review is not constitutional approval
narrowness_impacts.current_claim: Repository review can reject an unreviewed vocabulary widening but is not constitutional approval, entrenchment, or complete semantic certification.
narrowness_impacts.reason: The admission-widening case is accepted by the engine and then rejected by the current assertion-surface pipeline at source/inventory reconciliation; this is repository exposure, not an Article 9 verdict.
narrowness_impacts.future_trigger: Reassess if vocabulary changes acquire a constitutional approval route, entrenchment, independently reviewed meaning, and complete consequence analysis.

narrowness_impacts.current_claim: The amendment machinery decides which proposals receive an unread law label and applies no source change.
narrowness_impacts.reason: The audit applies every candidate mutation manually and verifies that label verdict and source effect remain independent; it adds no `become` reader.
narrowness_impacts.future_trigger: Revise the chapter, its pins, and this impact if any `become` reader or source-transition rule applies a labelled proposal.

narrowness_impacts.artifact_ref: book-1/method.md::the candidate edits are applied manually by the audit, not
narrowness_impacts.current_claim: The audit executes bounded manually paired candidate edits and label verdicts; it does not show that the amendment machinery applied them.
narrowness_impacts.reason: Exact fragment and candidate digests make the manual pairing reproducible while preserving the no-reader and no-transition boundary.
narrowness_impacts.future_trigger: Revise if `become` gains a verified source-effect reader or an authenticated transition harness applies approved exact text.

acceptance_result.claim: The current mechanism classifies self-declared labels but does not bind them to candidate source effects: targetless and harmless-labelled proposals receive passing labels while this audit separately applies exact floor deletions; even the honest floor proposal's blocked label prevents no separately applied deletion; a concealed one-line shape change removes a floor while retaining one firewall refusal; an unrelated target fact flips an ordinary verdict; and Article 0a can be widened directly even when the candidate also puts `Art_Evidence` on the register, because no proposal label binds that entry to the widening.
does_not_establish: No case proves that `become` enacted a source delta or that `false` prevented one.
No finite case set proves semantic completeness or finds every concealed effect.
No source author, reviewer, approval, transition, deployment, rollback, or liveness property is authenticated.
No new amendment, vocabulary, or withholding gate is enacted in the live constitution.
acceptance_result.remaining_boundary: Semantic entrenchment requires an external exact-diff and effect-review contract plus executable structural-wall, consequence, narrowness, and transition checks; those controls must themselves be tested against capture and withholding.
